phrases.latin: Hīs addidit ēlectridis artificēs et plumbāriōs, quī fīla et fistulās per parietēs dūcunt.
phrases.english: To these he added the electricians and plumbers, who run the wires and pipes through the walls.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 166, 309.

Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
